paper.title: Building Cooperative Embodied Agents Modularly with Large Language Models
paper.central_claim: A cognitive-inspired modular LLM agent can plan, communicate and cooperate efficiently with AI agents and humans in decentralized, partially observed long-horizon embodied tasks with costly communication; GPT-4 CoELA surpasses planning baselines, and filtered agent-generated data can improve an open-model CoLLAMA.

evidence.quote: decentralized settings with costly communication
evidence.support_explanation: The actual bottleneck includes deciding what AND when to say under partial observation, not merely adding multiple LLMs.

evidence.quote: first decide on what to send, then decide whether to send this message or choose another plan
evidence.support_explanation: Message generation is provisional; the planner selects between communication and environmental actions.

evidence.quote: We compile all available actions regarding the current state into an Action List for the LLMs to select from.
evidence.support_explanation: A state-compiled semantic vocabulary constrains planning; this is not raw motor control.

evidence.quote: we mainly use an A-star-based planner to find the shortest path for navigation and robustly interact with the objects according to rules.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit solver/executor boundary; downstream procedures carry navigation and interaction competence.

evidence.quote: the Procedural Memory is never updated except for fine-tuning the model parameters
evidence.support_explanation: No online reusable skill-library self-improvement. Semantic/episodic memory is state tracking, not retained harness revision.

evidence.quote: a test set of 24 episodes, and instantiate the horizon h with 3000 frames
evidence.support_explanation: TDW-MAT episode denominator and horizon.

evidence.quote: over 5 runs for RHP and 1 run for CoELA due to cost constraints
evidence.support_explanation: Unequal repetition and single-run CoELA limit autonomous-result confidence and trigger v2 measurement ceiling.

evidence.quote: cooperating with CoELA leads to a higher TR and EI than cooperating with another RHP (0.69(36%) v.s. 0.61(29%))
evidence.support_explanation: The reported gain is transport fraction/efficiency against RHP; not a binary trial-success rate.

evidence.quote: over 5 runs for MHP and 1 run for CoELA due to cost constraints
evidence.support_explanation: Same repetition problem in C-WAH; table reports mean completion steps, not uncertainty.

evidence.quote: 8 human subjects
evidence.support_explanation: Human-study participant denominator, distinct from autonomous episodes.

evidence.quote: making 80 trials in total
evidence.support_explanation: Human-study total trials across four conditions, not 80 independent runs per condition.

evidence.quote: trust score of 6.3 v.s. 4.7 for CoELA v.s CoELA w/o communication, p=0.0003 over the t-test
evidence.support_explanation: Limited evidence that communication supports human trust; subjective ratings do not establish robot safety.

evidence.quote: We did not observe a significant performance drop when disabling communication among AI agents
evidence.support_explanation: Direct counterevidence to communication being a demonstrated causal driver of AI-agent task efficiency.

evidence.quote: the steps needed to finish the task for the agent with no Memory Module nearly double
evidence.support_explanation: Memory ablation supports relevance of state/history retention, without full quantitative uncertainty.

evidence.quote: two floorplans are for the training set and another two are for the test set
evidence.support_explanation: Scene split exists for perception/student training; does not certify harness-development holdout.

evidence.quote: Agent position and rotation : the agent’s position and rotation in the simulation world
evidence.support_explanation: World-coordinate privilege matters to map/executor feasibility; raw-RGB-only claim would be too strong.

evidence.quote: manually filtered 572 high-quality data with effective communication behavior and good reasoning trace towards collaborative decision-making
evidence.support_explanation: Human selection, not an automatic self-improvement acceptance gate. Dataset admission counts disclosed; reproducible quality labels and difficulty distribution absent.

evidence.quote: We collected 2k trajectories from 10 episodes in the training set of TDW-MAT
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher-source size and training-episode scope for CoLLAMA.

evidence.quote: Limited usage of 3D spatial information.
evidence.support_explanation: Language planner lacks usable geometric structure despite geometric executor; negative boundary of method response.

evidence.quote: temperature 0.7, top-p 1, and max tokens 256
evidence.support_explanation: Sampling budget partly specified; this is not actual end-to-end token/call/latency accounting.

evidence.quote: a test set of 10 episodes and instantiate the horizon h with 250 steps
evidence.support_explanation: C-WAH fixed test denominator and horizon.

evidence.quote: Huang et al. (2022b) built an inner monologue with environment feedback to improve planning
evidence.support_explanation: Author-provided predecessor description only; independently verified lineage restricted to fixed p005 materials.

evidence.quote: all our trials perform poorly and struggle to finish any task
evidence.support_explanation: Removing the executor is qualitatively poor, but uncounted trials cannot isolate a fair matched-budget executor effect.

evidence.quote: Oracle Perception: it is an image where each object id is mapped to a color
evidence.support_explanation: Even C-WAH visual mode has oracle ID perception; distinguish it from TDW learned perception.

evidence.quote: incorrect reasoning over the number of unsatisfied goals
evidence.support_explanation: Counterexample: semantic feasibility and memory do not ensure correct remaining-goal reasoning.

signatures.object: Two embodied household agents executing multi-object predicates
signatures.information: Local RGB-D, calibrated world pose, learned TDW segmentation or C-WAH symbolic/oracle-ID inputs; shared task; last-observed teammate state; received broadcasts, not free shared current observations.
signatures.operation: Perceive/update semantic and episodic memory; generate provisional message; compile feasible high-level actions; LLM selects message or environmental plan; A-star/rules execute primitives; refresh observation.
signatures.output: A semantic action including an optional natural-language broadcast and low-level environment actions.
signatures.conditions: Noise-free broadcast, reliable pose/depth/procedures, two-agent settings, accurate enough memory and task counts.
signatures.feedback: Environment observation, changed goal progress, teammate messages feed later planning. No independent communication-truth validator.
signatures.selection_rule: State-dependent action list and LLM next-plan choice; communication has environment-time cost.
signatures.data: TDW-MAT/C-WAH observations and task predicates; prompt templates and two seed messages.
signatures.persistence: Episode semantic map, progress, last K actions/D dialogues; procedural code fixed.
signatures.later_use: Subsequent planning in same episode reuses state/history; no claimed cross-task harness revision.
signatures.claimed_effect: More efficient cooperation without putting LLM at each motor step.
signatures.failure_boundary: Stale partner state, poor geometric reasoning, incorrect counts, low-level action blindness, no robust benefit from AI communication removal control.

signatures.information: GPT-4 CoELA training-set trajectories plus human quality judgments.
signatures.operation: Generate about 2k trajectories from 10 training episodes, retain 572 manually judged examples, LoRA finetune; deploy adapter inside otherwise static CoELA.
signatures.conditions: Human selection quality, training/test scene separation, same semantic deployment interface.
signatures.feedback: Manual communication/reasoning judgments, not online learner-state corrections.
signatures.selection_rule: Human high-quality communication/reasoning filter; counts known, annotation protocol and reject distribution not supplied.
signatures.persistence: LoRA/model parameters; not runtime procedural-memory invention.
signatures.later_use: Deploy CoLLAMA on TDW-MAT test episodes; reported 0.70 TR versus GPT-4 0.71 and raw LLAMA-2 0.53 in Table 1.
signatures.failure_boundary: Selected data, extra training, teacher and model changes not isolated at matched budget; single-run evaluation.

gap.author_gap: Distributed embodied cooperation with partial observations and time-consuming natural-language communication is not covered by cost-free dialogue or centralized fully shared-state planners.
gap.checked_gap: The fixed text specifies the two-agent information/action contract and shows RHP/MHP baselines. This establishes a practical bottleneck, not an independently closed historical novelty claim.

lineage.neighbor: Inner Monologue (Huang et al. 2022b), SayCan (Ahn et al. 2022), Code as Policies (Liang et al. 2022)
lineage.verification: Author related-work account only; predecessor originals not in frozen batch.
Independently read neighboring multi-robot role dialogue with external feasibility repair; it provides a mechanism comparator, not proof of temporal priority.

gap.closest_adjacent: RHP/MHP with explicit template progress/intent/belief broadcasts, described in Appendix C.2/F.
gap.residue: When-to-send choice and high-level collaborative reasoning under decentralized observation, rather than basic pathfinding or unconstrained multi-LLM chat.
gap.stakes: Unnecessary talk and duplicate subgoals consume finite environment steps; missing task/partner state compounds long-horizon errors.
gap.method_response: Separate communication candidate generation from action selection; preserve structured state/history; delegate motor execution.
gap.remaining_gap: No causal AI-efficiency gain from communication; geometry/low-level reasoning and stale partner information remain; two-agent results do not establish scale or real-robot robustness.
unresolved: Originals of named predecessor papers absent; residual novelty and chronological nearest-neighbor completeness remain provisional.
No audit of which test scenes/tasks informed prompt/harness engineering.

rs_pattern.reason: High-level learned plan selection delegates motion/interaction to classical procedures; frozen GPT-4 deployment conditions on state/history. Fine-tuned CoLLAMA remains separately tracked.
rs_pattern.executes_pattern: Yes at main-card level: semantic action → procedural executor; conditioning applies to frozen runtime.
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: Partially. System gains exist on two simulators, but efficient AI communication is not causally established.

tactic_steps_checked.reason: Action list selection delegates navigation and rules rather than a direct motor answer.
State constraints and episode feedback exist, but no explicit solver-verdict→LLM artifact-repair loop like RoCo; do not force rs:C25.
Executor ablation qualitative; memory ablation and communication counterexample explicit; latency unpriced.

pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: Reliable executor/pose required; dynamic action filtering is not C25 solver-feedback repair.

pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: No free common-state oracle assumed for partner, but memory can be stale; actual multi-robot allocation/repair is implicit and only two agents.

claims.text: CoELA improves cooperative transport/household efficiency over strong planning baselines.
claims.setting: TDW-MAT visual/oracle tracks and C-WAH symbolic/visual tracks, two agents.
claims.baseline_control: RHP/MHP single/two-agent partners; MAT oracle centralized separate; no same-backbone equivalent-cost harness.
claims.budgets: 24 TDW episodes ×3000 frames and 10 C-WAH episodes ×250 steps; CoELA one stochastic run vs five baseline runs.
claims.selection_vs_test: Training scenes separate in TDW; prompt-development use of evaluation set unknown.
claims.result_denominator: TDW partner TR .69 vs .61, CoELA pair .71; C-WAH pair 57 symbolic/92 visual steps vs MHP pair75/103; TR is subgoal fraction, not episode SR.
counterevidence: Single-run autonomous method, unknown C-WAH timeout treatment in mean-step reporting, privileged visual modes; no uncertainty-comparable per-task table.
alternative_explanations: Executor/state abstraction, model strength and memory differences.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported closed-loop efficiency improvements within these simulation contracts, not robust universal cooperative superiority.

claims.text: Natural-language communication supports effective cooperation with AI agents and humans.
claims.setting: AI ablations and eight-subject simulated C-WAH study.
claims.baseline_control: CoELA without communication; MHP with template communications and humans alone.
claims.budgets: 80 human trials total across four scenarios; same ten tasks and tutorial familiarity.
claims.selection_vs_test: Same task set as autonomous evaluation; not independent task-family transfer.
claims.result_denominator: Trust6.3 vs4.7,p=.0003; removing communication does not significantly reduce AI task performance.
counterevidence: No demonstrated autonomous efficiency drop without communication; small participant pool; subjective trust not validated safety.
alternative_explanations: Human legibility, responsiveness and preferences rather than better AI coordination.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Communication is useful for human interaction/trust in this study; its causal AI-cooperation efficiency benefit remains unproven.

claims.text: Fine-tuning an open CoLLAMA on filtered CoELA data achieves promising cooperative performance.
claims.baseline_control: Untuned LLAMA-2 and GPT-4-driven CoELA; not a data-/compute-matched training ablation.
claims.budgets: 2k trajectories from10 training episodes,572 human-selected examples,30 epochs.
claims.selection_vs_test: Teacher data from training episodes; admission quality selection not reproducible, test floorplans distinct.
claims.result_denominator: Table1 visual TR .70 CoLLAMA vs .53 LLAMA-2 and .71 GPT-4 over fixed24 episodes/single method run.
counterevidence: Selection/training/teacher contributions not separated; small data-source breadth and single evaluation run.
alternative_explanations: Extra supervision and human selection rather than an autonomous self-improvement algorithm.
claims.allowed_conclusion: A useful offline teacher-data fine-tuning demonstration; not online harness learning or causal proof of the filtering rule.

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Environment-grounded closed-loop tasks counted in two simulator families. TDW scene split exists, but no construction-unseen harness audit; do not upgrade solely on two co-designed rearrangement benchmarks.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With semantic memory, state-constrained plans and hand-engineered execution, GPT-4 CoELA has author-reported cooperative simulation gains; communication particularly supports human trust, whereas AI communication necessity is not established.
unresolved: Independent predecessor novelty, harness-development overlap, comparable autonomous repetition, end-to-end cost and communication causality.
assessment.reproduction: None; all empirical findings are author-reported.

G.reason: Concrete important decentralized/time-cost bottleneck and baseline lineage, but independent predecessor originals unavailable and demonstrated communication residual not closed.

M.reason: Explicit message-then-choice design and solver delegation fit the decision/control bottleneck and predict fewer unnecessary motor-model calls; stale-state/geometry and implicit coordination remain.

X.reason: Action list, memory lifecycle, prompts and procedural executor reconstruct the static loop; oracle permissions disclosed. Partner consistency, execution recovery and selection reproducibility remain incomplete.

measurement.reason: Goals/horizons and episode counts ground closed-loop metrics, but main CoELA evaluations are single runs; apply v2 ceiling <=2. Visual/symbolic oracle channels and mean-step failure accounting limit stronger truth claims.

causality.reason: Useful memory/communication and model probes; no communication necessity among AI, no matched-budget alternative harness, and bundled system effects remain.

holdout.reason: TDW training/test floorplans separated and two environments used, but task families and body setup are narrow and harness-development contamination untested.

statistics.reason: Episode counts and limited human t-test exist, but stochastic autonomous CoELA is one run and failure categories lack quantitative denominators. This is not a zero-information paper, nor a repeated-autonomous study.

cost.reason: Environment horizons, action communication charges and inference token cap make budgets partly inferable. No all-attempt call/token/wall-clock/API accounting or budget-normalized controls.
